event_var.var_meaning: overall survival event indicator (1 = death, 0 = censored/alive at last follow-up)

notes: Variable names and values taken from GEO sample 'characteristics_ch1' fields in GSE100797 (e.g. GSM2693520 contains 'os.time: 92.9' and 'os.event: 0').

Units not stated in the GEO sample metadata; 'months' inferred from the paper text which reports survival in months (e.g. 'median overall survival (OS) was 22.8 months' and 'minimum follow-up of 37.2 months').

Event coding (1 = event, 0 = censored) is not explicitly defined in the GEO metadata and was inferred from patterns in the sample data (long os.time values paired with os.event: 0) and standard clinical convention.

event_var.var_meaning: progression-free survival event indicator (1 = progression and/or death, 0 = censored/no progression at last follow-up)

notes: Variable names and values taken from GEO sample 'characteristics_ch1' fields in GSE100797 (e.g. GSM2693520 contains 'pfs.time: 48.1' and 'pfs.event: 1').
Units not stated in the GEO sample metadata; 'months' inferred from the paper text (paper presents PFS outcomes in yearly/monthly terms and uses months elsewhere).

PFS event definition is not explicitly encoded in the GEO metadata; Methods state 'Response was assessed according to RECIST 1.0', so PFS is presumed to follow the standard RECIST-based definition (progression or death).
Event coding (1 = event, 0 = censored) is inferred from metadata patterns and standard conventions, not explicitly documented in the GEO file.
